headline: Per-rank byte factor is 1.00 at every size where both ranks agree (n=2 ring = 2(n-1)/n*S = S). The claimed 2.0->1.0 step does not exist; the 2.00 and 1.25 values are ONE duplicated retransmit of the first piece (same chan, same payload digest). ggh remains a real defect but its scope changes: the model's n=2 special case (bf=2.0) is wrong EVERYWHERE, not above a threshold -- delete the special case, use 2(n-1)/n.

table.note: 2nd send in some runs is a duplicate

duplicate_send_evidence.rank0: seq1..4 on chan 0,2,4,6 (4x65536=S) then seq5 on chan 2 with the SAME payload digest as seq2 -> duplicate retransmit
duplicate_send_evidence.cause: sending rank starts before peer attaches; the first piece is retried and traced as an extra send

model: src/fakegpu_nccl.c:402-408 chunk=(n==2)?1.0:(n-1)/n; bf=2.0*chunk -> 2.0 at n=2, commented 'one whole buffer per phase'. Measurement says 1.0 at n=2 everywhere.
ggh_ruling: NOT a non-defect. Rewrite scope: remove the n=2 special case (use 2(n-1)/n for all n) instead of adding a size threshold.
method_corrections: digest is fg_digest(payload) = content hash, never a phase marker
waiting rank must start first (rank0-first races at small S)
